metadata.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 ('computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650')

nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Traffic data including 10-minute traffic volumes and driving behavior parameters from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, used to calibrate simulation experiments.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The Data Availability section explicitly states the data is available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.node_name: Extract vehicle positions from video frames
nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations from raw images are extracted to reconstruct visual representations in the DRL method [24].
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle coordinates (xi, yi) from raw video frames to create position matrices. Traffic state is represented by stacking matrices from N consecutive time steps.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, generic tools used, missing specific detection method detail.

nodes_process.source_quote: For computation efficiency, down-sampling is introduced before the matrix stack to reduce the input dimensions
nodes_process.description: Zooms and down-samples the position matrices to reduce input dimensions while preserving vehicle positions. Stacks three consecutive frames into a single observation.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, precise dimensions given, tool generic.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network is trained in 10^6 training frames, and each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_process.description: Trains a CNN-based agent with experience replay and target networks. Uses multitask learning to predict mean speed and queue length alongside Q-values. Employs epsilon-greedy strategy and Adam optimizer.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, extensive parameters from Table 1, tools named.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator [31].
nodes_process.description: Simulates a freeway tunnel merge area using calibrated driving behavior parameters. Compares DRL against no-control and PI-ALINEA baselines across 20 experiments.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, scenarios well-defined, simulator version missing.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: Removes information from specific subareas of the control area to evaluate the impact on DRL control performance.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, procedure described but specific removal mechanism simplified.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Convergence curves for (a) episode reward and (b) mean travel time.
nodes_sink.description: Training convergence plots showing episode rewards and mean travel times across 1 million frames.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Hyperparameters and scenario are defined, but raw traffic volume files for simulation are not linked.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Vehicle travel times in the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Comparison of mainline travel times (min) over time for no control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Comparative scenarios and simulation environment (SUMO) are well-defined.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Mean vehicle travel times in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_sink.description: Statistical summary of travel times (s) and percentage improvements for 20 simulation runs across three control methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Individual experiment results provided, though random seeds for the 20 runs are not listed.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Temporal-spatial distribution of speed in (a) no-control; (b) PI-ALINEA; (c) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Heatmaps showing vehicle speeds (m/s) across time and road distance for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Visual representations follow from simulation data; grid resolution is not specified.

nodes_sink.description: Distribution (Q1, Q2, Q3) of on-ramp vehicle queue lengths (m) over time for three methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Measurement method for queue length in SUMO is standard but not explicitly detailed.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Relationship of queue length and red ratio for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Scatter plot and regression showing how on-ramp queues relate to signal red-phase duration.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Derived from simulation outputs; regression methodology is standard.

nodes_sink.description: Box plots of vehicle throughput (veh/h) downstream of the merge area over time intervals.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Aggregated throughput follows directly from simulation counts.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Travel time with perturbed input data.
nodes_sink.description: Sensitivity analysis showing travel times (s) when input video data from specific subareas is missing.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Perturbation method (zeroing subarea info) is clear, but exact masks for the 8 areas are not provided.
